records.text: Candace Owens said Brigitte Macron welcomed Volodymyr Zelensky in Paris on September 3 while 35 state leaders met to discuss security for Ukraine
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: President Zelensky is in town also, though. Brigitte Macron welcomes President Zelensky into Paris on September 3rd because there is this remarkable—and I would assume rare, I don't know, but—35 state leaders meet to discuss Ukraine, ... securing the security of Ukraine, okay?

verification.notes: Official French and Ukrainian records confirm that Zelensky arrived in Paris on September 3 for talks and dinner, followed on September 4 by a coalition meeting involving 35 countries. However, the Élysée and contemporaneous imagery identify Emmanuel Macron, not Brigitte Macron, as the person who welcomed Zelensky on September 3. The date, visit, and 35-country security meeting are correct; the named welcomer is not.

sources.title: Entretien avec Volodymyr Zelensky, Président de l'Ukraine, à Paris
sources.relevance: Official Élysée record says President Emmanuel Macron welcomed Zelensky on September 3 for talks and dinner.

sources.title: A Meeting of the Coalition of the Willing Took Place in Paris
sources.relevance: Official Ukrainian presidency record confirms the September 4 meeting and participation/contributions of 35 countries.
